mr_tab_description: Membership restrictions and declarations of traits, equipment and stats
mr_open_description: Declarations and requirements for this specific meta
mr_intro: Open the rules tab of an individual meta. Declarations and requirements appear together.
mr_admission_help: Requirements apply to new and current members. Incompatible members leave during the next update scan. Leaving a city or kingdom also ends city citizenship and army service.
mr_invalid_data: This meta has unsupported or invalid saved rules. Its data was preserved. See Player.log.
mr_restriction_hint: Each enabled restriction must pass. Within a restriction choose ALL or ANY conditions.
mr_declaration_hint: Declarations apply to existing and future members. Multiple stat bonuses add together.
mr_trait_help: Temporary grants are removed after leaving the group or disabling the declaration. Pre-existing traits and traits granted by another active group are preserved. Opposite traits are not forcibly removed.
mr_stat_help: Adds this amount while membership lasts. Bonuses stack across groups and do not accumulate on repeated updates. They do not directly heal units.
mr_provenance_help: Rules and trait provenance are saved with this world. Permanent grants remain after removing their declaration. Stat bonuses always require membership.
mr_choose_meta: Open a specific meta and select Rules.
mr_change_selection: Choose another trait, item or stat
mr_subspecies_help: Subspecies require a compatible alternative of the same species. If none exists, the creature remains and is counted as incompatible.
mr_toggle_rules: Click to pause or resume every rule of this meta.
mr_requirements_hint: Every active requirement must be met
mr_first_condition: Add a trait or a membership with +. Members who do not meet the requirement leave this group.
mr_select_condition: Click a condition to invert or remove it.
mr_item_help: Equipment is given once when a creature joins, replacing the item in that slot (the old item goes to its city's storage). If the creature later swaps or loses it, it is not given again until it rejoins. While a member: removed on leaving, if still carried. Permanent: kept. Only creatures that use items receive equipment; if several groups declare the same slot, the first group wins.
mr_meta_help: Every member is made to join this group: a kingdom imposing its language, a clan whose members serve in an army and live in a city. It only happens when the game allows it (advanced creatures; clan not full and of the same species; no culture forbidding conversion; cities that welcome the creature; kings and city leaders do not move; armies only take residents of their city as warriors, within the army limit) and when no requirement — of the target or of any group the creature keeps — would be broken. Changing city also changes kingdom and leaves the old army. If several groups grant the same type, the first one wins; a granted city takes precedence over a granted kingdom. Leaving does not undo it.
mr_removed_paused: Rules are paused: removed individuals can rejoin until you resume them.
mr_members_help: Use Add members to find living creatures by name or ID. Adding transfers them from their previous group of this type and obeys requirements and game limits. Family/subspecies transfers require the same species; changing family does not rewrite ancestry. Removing expels and bans the creature while rules are active. Allow back only lifts the ban; use Add to return it immediately.
mr_member_add_blocked: Cannot add: check requirements, removals, cultural conversion settings and game limits (species, capacity, city, age or role).
mr_override_cultural_block Description: Global setting, off by default. When enabled, declarations and manual additions ignore cultural conversion blocks such as True Roots. Your requirements, removals and structural game limits still apply. Native conversions are unchanged. Turning this off does not undo completed transfers.
mr_impact_all: All {0} members would leave: this group would be emptied!
mr_confirm_empty: Empty the group? Click to confirm
